cs.t: Wow, I wish. I've been using a couple of ryzen laptops (an HP with a 2500u, then an HP with a 3700u) for about 5 years. It works pretty well, except: When the laptop wakes up there's a good chance that the UI shows up but I can't click on anything or type. I can then reboot by holding Alt-SysReq and typing REISUB. Or:  The screen is still black, and nothing works, as above. I can run games, though if I play something like GTA-V, it will eventually get too hot and I have to hard reset. This is because the fan control doesn't properly work.
cs.th: Linux on the laptop works so damn well that it’s boring
